details.description: Yi-6B is a 6-billion-parameter open-weight base language model from 01.AI, released alongside Yi-9B and Yi-34B as part of the original Yi series. It uses a Llama-style transformer architecture built independently with 01.AI's own training data and infrastructure (the maker states it is not a Llama derivative) and was pretrained on 3 trillion tokens of English and Chinese text, with data current through June 2023. As a base, non-instruction-tuned model, it is offered under the Apache 2.0 license as a foundation for research, personal or commercial use and for further fine-tuning; it has since been followed by 01.AI's improved Yi-1.5 series.
advantages: Pretrained on 3 trillion tokens of English and Chinese text, giving it bilingual language coverage.
Distributed under the Apache 2.0 license, permitting free personal, academic and commercial use.
disadvantages: This is the base, non-instruction-tuned pretrained model; 01.AI separately offers a Yi-6B-Chat variant for conversational use.
Pretraining data extends only through June 2023.
Superseded by 01.AI's Yi-1.5 series (released May 2024), which the maker describes as improving coding, math, reasoning and instruction-following over the original Yi models.
use_cases: Foundation for fine-tuning specialized downstream models

sources.title: 01-ai/Yi: A series of large language models trained from scratch by developers @01-ai

notes: Catalog's facts list 4096 max input/output tokens, matching the model card's stated 4K native context for the base model; the card separately notes context can be extended to 32K at inference time, but the catalog value is kept as authoritative. No specific numeric benchmark scores for Yi-6B alone were found on the model card (only qualitative claims), so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. Verify pass: removed two claims that were actually about sibling models rather than Yi-6B itself — the 4-bit/8-bit quantized versions on the model card are for Yi-6B-Chat, not the Yi-6B base model, and the "cost-effective for small and medium enterprises" positioning is stated by 01.AI for the 34B series, not Yi-6B.
